name: TCI Finance Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1973, TCI Finance is a NBFC registered with the RBI. It offers various financial services like loan against shares, IP Valuation etc. [1]
keyPoints:
Services offered[1]
Loans against Securities, commercial vehicles finance, Patents Trademark & Copyright, IP valuations, Inter Corporate Deposits, Ecommerce Seller Funding and other financial products.

cons: The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -56.0% over past five years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.6.70 Cr.
